title: Design System: Abiral Bhattarai — AI × Product

display.purpose: Hero, stage chapter and contact headlines only.

title.purpose: Row titles in work, focus areas and research; smaller steps in timeline and stage.

subhead.purpose: The single muted line under a chapter headline.

lede.purpose: Intro paragraphs in hero and contact.

body.purpose: Running copy in muted ink, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Tags, pipeline stage tabs, post-platform chips, the Resume pill.

data.purpose: Fragment Mono for dates, timestamps, URLs and tech identifiers only.

shadows.name: signal-halo
shadows.purpose: Focus halo on the stage's lime go chip during the first scroll step only.

shadows.name: caption-shadow
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow on burned-in captions inside the phone mock, imitating real social-video captions.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: state-slow
motion.purpose: Theme switch, stage step changes, step opacity.

motion.name: wave-grow
motion.purpose: Hero waveform bars grow from 15% height; words rise after 1.6s, bracket fades in at 2.4s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every animated element shows its settled state.

motion.name: graph-flow
motion.purpose: Dash flowing along the agent graph's ReAct loop edges; static under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Nav text links hide; agent graph swaps to its mobile drawing; focus rows stack.

narrative.overview:
The site presents work the way a flagship product is launched: one headline at a time, set huge and heavy, with one product demonstrated in motion. White ground and soft grey panels carry near-black ink; one black chapter holds the product demo; ultramarine marks every action and finally drenches the closing section.

Density is low and the rhythm is vertical. Each chapter opens with a headline at display or headline scale, a muted one-line subhead, then content laid out as hairline-ruled rows, never as cards. Light and dark themes are both first-class, switched by `data-theme` on `<html>`; the black product chapter stays black in both.

Motion is exponential ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), scroll-stepped where it tells a story, and reduced-motion always shows the final state.
keyCharacteristics: Display type at weight 850 with tight tracking (-0.045em) and line-height under 1.
Hairline rules (1px) separate rows; a full-ink 1px rule opens each list.
Pill-shaped actions, ultramarine for the primary one.
One dark "stage" chapter with a lime signal for the product's own outputs.
No cards, no drop shadows on surfaces.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine means "act here" or "a person decides". Do not spend it on decoration; muted ink and hairlines do the rest.

rules.name: The Lime Stays On Stage Rule
rules.body: Signal lime appears only on black. On white it fails contrast; where the stage's lime would fall on the light page, ultramarine stands in.

rules.name: The Local Remap Rule
rules.body: Inverted sections (the black stage, the ultramarine contact drench) redefine `--ink`, `--ink-2` and `--line` locally instead of introducing new component variants, so every row, pill and rule inside them inherits correctly.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size, never from case: no uppercase labels outside the in-product caption mock, no small eyebrow lines above headlines.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono is used only for timestamps, dates, URLs, ratios and tech identifiers. Never for headings or prose.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. Group content with rules and bands; the stage panel is the single bordered container, and it is a device, not a card.

dos: Do set every chapter headline at weight 850 with -0.045em tracking and line-height under 1.
Do use ultramarine for the primary action and for marks that mean "a person decides".
Do separate content with 1px hairlines and open lists with a full-ink rule.
Do redefine `--ink`, `--ink-2` and `--line` locally when a section inverts.
Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for transitions and show final states under reduced motion.
Do check every new color pairing in both light and dark themes.
donts: Don't put signal lime on a white or grey ground.
Don't wrap content in cards or add drop shadows to surfaces.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or kicker lines above headlines.
Don't use Fragment Mono for anything that is not data.
Don't introduce a second action color.
